result.summary: Identified a few visual design and readability issues on the main screen.

issues.description: White text inside the light green promotion banner suffers from very low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text color or adjust banner background for better legibility.

issues.suggestion: Allow text to wrap to a second line or adjust container width.
